Figure 83, you may sign-in here by entering your username and password, you

if your accounts email is not yet verified, you may press the button in the top 
right of the screen. If you do not have an account please press the register 
button, and if you have forgotten your password, please press the forgot 
password button. 
Figure 84 to register an account your password must have at least: 8 characters, 
1 number, 1 upper case, 1 lower case, 1 symbol. 
Valid example: “Password123!” 
Invalid example: “ben123”
